items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 04 September 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the north of Scotland.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, decreasing west 4 or 5 late in the night, then mainly 4 occasionally 5 in places from mid-morning. Backing southwest during the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest, backing south, mainly 4 occasionally 5 in places Saturday evening. Increasing 5 or 6 overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle overnight into Sunday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or drizzle.
